# `csharp_place_field_attribute_on_same_line`

Where a field's attribute section goes.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `own_line` |  |
| `if_owner_is_single_line` |  |

**Default:** `own_line`

### `csharp_place_field_attribute_on_same_line = own_line`

```ini
csharp_place_field_attribute_on_same_line = own_line
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    [Obsolete]
    public void OldWay() { }

    [Obsolete("use NewWay")]
    public string OldName { get; set; } = "";
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    [Obsolete]
    public void OldWay() { }

    [Obsolete("use NewWay")]
    public string OldName { get; set; } = "";
}
```
